name: San Diego County (Unincorporated)
disclaimer: Applies only to unincorporated county areas. Incorporated cities within San Diego County have their own ordinances. Verify with the San Diego County Department of Planning & Development Services.

notes: County largely mirrors state ADU law. Verify current County ADU ordinance at PDS.
Fire Safety Areas (FSA) may impose additional construction requirements (ignition-resistant materials, Class A roofing).
Grading permit required for cut/fill exceeding 50 cubic yards.

citations.general: San Diego County Zoning Ordinance §6156.x (ADU regulations)
citations.fire_safety: San Diego County Fire Code — Fire Safety Areas

garage_conversion.setback_note: Existing structure setbacks maintained per state law.

fire.default_hazard_note: Much of unincorporated San Diego County is in SRA (State Responsibility Area) or VHFHSZ. Verify parcel-level designation at CAL FIRE.

citations.wui: CA Building Code Chapter 7A; San Diego County Local Amendments
